```python
import pandas as pd
import seaborn as sns
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt

# Load the iris dataset
iris_df = pd.read_csv('data/iris.csv')

# Create a pairplot to visualize the relationships
sns.set(style="whitegrid")
pairplot = sns.pairplot(iris_df, hue='species', palette='Set1', markers=["o", "s", "D"])

# Add a title and adjust layout
pairplot.fig.suptitle("Pairplot of Iris Dataset", y=1.02)
pairplot.add_legend(title='Species')

# Save the figure
plt.savefig('output.png', bbox_inches='tight', dpi=150)
```
